escaped_defects.scenario: A planned_task capsule with a missing or mismatched plan/task identity must block instead of replanning.
A receipt returned while its host worker is still working must not complete the task or release the next dispatch.
A fresh pass that becomes stale or failing must replace current acceptance truth while archiving the prior revision.
A Git path containing a backslash must remain out of scope when only the slash-normalized path is owned.
Changing VERSION alone must create a new controller snapshot identity and must not reuse stale frozen content.
A blocked run may append host terminal cleanup evidence for existing workers, but must not register workers, rewrite task facts, or return to active/complete.
Writing complete through a legacy state shape must still require current Source Receipt and per-acceptance Evidence Receipt gates.
A host plan acknowledgement transition must not also advance execution stage or rewrite any other task fact.
A Plan v6 containing an open, malformed, or unstructured decision must block before execution instead of returning valid.
Final plan audit with incomplete tasks, stale evidence, source-chain gaps, or scope drift must return a non-zero completion-gate exit.
A candidate must not change or redirect the judge, catalog, or evaluator used to decide whether that candidate passes.
A caller-provided worker list or parallel registry must not replace the managed Single State v10 registry and its host-observed terminal tree receipt.
Absolute, parent-traversal, or backslash-disguised touched paths must not pass an allowed repository scope.
A selector crash or invalid output must be reported as an execution error and must not preserve a perfect trigger F1.
Zero or wholly skipped tests and option values masquerading as selectors must not pass GREEN. Unrelated selected tests must not supply an empty target count.
Echo, unknown tools, zero mutations, surviving or inconclusive mutants and mismatched campaign selectors must not satisfy mutation evidence.
Plan and final closure must reject self-attested hashes and successful explore output without current structured file and caller-edge observations.
A timed-out graph subquery must not leave descendants writing after a receipt; unconfirmed cleanup must prevent receipt issuance.
Valid JSON with invalid object or nested element shapes must return no graph proof without an unhandled AttributeError.
A real unittest expectedFailure and exit-zero runner summaries containing failures, errors or expected failures must not satisfy GREEN; ordinary passing results remain valid.
Clean status must not certify stale content hashes, newly committed source files, deleted source or a changing/corrupt SQLite index; a matching index must remain usable.
